## Purpose

The files sitting **directly** in `apps/dashboard/src/` are the composition root; everything else lives in a subfolder that has its own convention. `main.tsx` is deliberately tiny: it imports `./i18n` first for its side effect, then mounts `React.StrictMode` over `QueryClientProvider` (with the shared `queryClient` from `lib/query-client`) over `App`, pulls the fontsource CSS plus `./style.css`, and installs the one global listener the desktop shell needs. `App.tsx` owns routing — a `HashRouter` (the app is served from the Tauri shell, not a path-routed server), one `<Route>` per page, the global `<Toaster>` and `<CommandPalette>` mounted inside `<AppShell>`, and the once-on-mount side effects (start the FS watcher over the discovered project paths, subscribe to the fs-change event, hydrate the projects registry). `i18n.ts` is the single i18next catalogue with a pt-BR and an en-US block under the `common` namespace, and is the one file allowed to carry pt-BR strings (its header marks them as data, not narrative).

## Convention

- Folder: `apps/dashboard/src/` root only; 4 TypeScript files (`main.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `i18n.ts`, `vite-env.d.ts`) plus `style.css`.
- `App.tsx` uses a default export; pages and components everywhere else use named exports.
- Effects that depend on a fetched array key on a derived stable string (`pathsKey`), never on the array identity.

## How to apply

A new page is created under `src/pages/` and wired with exactly one `<Route>` line in `App.tsx` — add a short comment when the route only exists for a legacy deep-link. Do not add providers to `main.tsx` unless they are genuinely app-wide; page-scoped state belongs in a `lib/*-store.ts`. Every new user-visible string gets a key added to **both** the pt-BR and the en-US blocks of `i18n.ts`, keeping the existing grouping comments and the plural suffixes. Resist creating additional root-level files: a new concern belongs in `lib/`, `hooks/`, `api/`, `components/` or `features/`.

## Examples

- Ref: `apps/dashboard/src/main.tsx` — provider stack and the `./i18n` side-effect import ordering.
- Ref: `apps/dashboard/src/App.tsx` — `HashRouter` route table, watcher bootstrap, `pathsKey` effect guard.
- Ref: `apps/dashboard/src/i18n.ts` — dual-locale catalogue, `setLanguage`, html lang sync on language change.
